title: Laredo honors its veterans with downtown parade
excerpt: Laredo marked Veterans Day on Wednesday with a ceremony at Jarvis Plaza and a parade down San Bernardo Avenue to the Webb County Courthouse, with JROTC groups, veterans, marching bands and crowds lining the sidewalks.
content:
Laredo honored its veterans on Wednesday with a parade through downtown, according to KGNS.

The day began with a Veterans Day ceremony at 8 a.m. at the Veterans Monument at Jarvis Plaza. The parade followed at 10 a.m., marching down San Bernardo Avenue and ending at the Webb County Courthouse.

The parade featured JROTC groups, veterans and community organizations. Marching bands played along the route, and Laredo's drum corps performed a ceremonial piece, according to KGNS.

Community members lined the sidewalks to watch and honor the veterans. "Everybody needs to come out and participate — this is something that you only get to see once a year," Laredo resident Roberto García told KGNS.

"It's truly beautiful to see the families come together and honor our veterans," City of Laredo communications specialist Jennifer Rodriguez told KGNS.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 11, 2026; kgns.tv.
